doc.title: Louis Hayes interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 29, 2000

title: Rehearsing: Horace Silver versus Cannonball
summary: Silver rehearsed thoroughly while Cannonball's band was more spontaneous.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Big band discipline versus small-group freedom

blocks.x: Did the band rehearse at all?

Yes, we rehearsed, but it wasn’t like Horace though. Now Horace rehearsed quite a bit. And when he went into the studio Horace — we had played the choruses, played the compositions, so all the little things were worked out, what we were going to do. But with Cannon it wasn’t like that. Cannon was more spontaneous. We rehearsed, we had it together, but everybody was so talented we didn’t — it was more spontaneous. We didn’t rehearse all the time like that.
